title: Felid: A Flexible and Efficient Design for Transformer Fine-Tuning over Encrypted Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.27175v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) enables non-interactive, privacy-preserving transformer fine-tuning, protecting highly sensitive data as inputs to large language models. Prior work has predominantly pursued efficiency gains through architectural refinements, yet overall performance remains bounded by the substantial cost inherent in encrypted computation. To address these issues, we target the bottleneck at the ciphertext operation level. Concretely, we propose a novel packing strategy that supports batching over a flexible number of inputs, making it well-suited for fine-tuning workloads. In addition, we design operation-specific matrix evaluation algorithms that significantly reduce (i) the number of ciphertext rotations and relinearizations, and (ii) the number of bootstrapping invocations. Additionally, we exploit functional bootstrapping to fold the evaluation of element-wise activation functions directly into the bootstrapping

translated_title: Felid：一种面向加密数据上Transformer微调的灵活高效设计
translated_abstract: 全同态加密（FHE）能够实现非交互式、隐私保护的Transformer微调，保护作为大语言模型输入的高度敏感数据。以往的工作主要通过架构改进来追求效率提升，但整体性能仍受限于加密计算固有的高昂成本。为解决这些问题，我们将优化目标瞄准在密文操作层面的瓶颈。具体而言，我们提出了一种新颖的打包策略，支持对灵活数量的输入进行批处理，使其非常适合微调工作负载。此外，我们设计了针对特定操作的矩阵求值算法，显著减少了（i）密文旋转和重线性化的次数，以及（ii）自举调用的次数。另外，我们利用函数自举技术，将逐元素激活函数的求值直接折叠到自举过程中。
tldr: 该论文提出Felid，一种在加密数据上进行Transformer微调的灵活高效设计，通过新颖的打包策略、面向特定操作的矩阵求值算法以及函数自举技术，从密文操作层面显著减少了密文旋转、重线性化和自举的开销。
en_tdlr: Felid is a flexible and efficient design for transformer fine-tuning over encrypted data that targets bottlenecks at the ciphertext operation level, significantly reducing rotations, relinearizations, and bootstrapping invocations through a novel packing strategy, operation-specific matrix evaluation algorithms, and functional bootstrapping.
